I visited the shop recently after decades.  With all the digging for the Metro and the one ways, it is tricky to find it, but the sense of familiarity instantly returns the minute you enter.

They've innovated with the times of course, so sadly many of their beautiful letter paper designs have been discontinued. Long may they survive and thrive.
